summary: Approved as readable, behavior-validated unmatched C++ with zero matching-source byte credit.
reason: Source control flow, signed comparisons, wraparound arithmetic, layouts, helper sequencing and return behavior agree with original assembly. Submitted tests call the original across 480 meaningful cases and compare state, globals and allocator effects. An independent 48-case countercheck using original instructions and controlled helpers passed, including overflow branches and helper mutations. Source hashes match validation; native compilation records cover the actual implementation. VM error integration, protected unwinding and panic paths remain explicitly untested. Sampled validation does not establish all-input equivalence.
